# `hub.user_homes`

Each person's chosen start page (R191): where signing in and the Home button land. Starting location is not permission.

Database: `hub`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | users.id | The person whose Home this is. |
| `company_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company the Home page is in; a company since retired leaves the Home unavailable. |
| `path` | VARCHAR(400) | no | — | — | — | — | Workbench page inside that company, such as `report/profit-and-loss`; empty for the Overview. |
| `version` | INTEGER | no | 1 | — | — | — | Optimistic-concurrency version of this record. |
| `set_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp when the Home was last set. |
| `set_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | User id who last set it (the person, or someone holding user.manage). |
| `set_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface it was last set through. |
